description: Defines the CmduServer class, an interface for a server component handling CMDU message sending, receiving, forwarding, and client connection management within the beerocks namespace. It includes handler function types, event handler registration, and notification methods.

classes.name: CmduServer
classes.description: Interface class for a CMDU message server handling client connections, message transmission, forwarding, and event notifications within the beerocks namespace.

classes.name: EventHandlers
classes.description: Struct grouping optional callback handlers for client connection, disconnection, and CMDU reception events.

methods.name: set_handlers
methods.description: Registers event handler functions for server events.

methods.name: clear_handlers
methods.description: Clears all previously set event handlers.

methods.name: send_cmdu
methods.description: Sends a CMDU message through a specified socket.

methods.name: forward_cmdu
methods.description: Forwards a received CMDU message to a client.

methods.name: set_client_name
methods.description: Associates a client name with a socket descriptor for event handling.
